title: [Refurbished] Higround Blackice Performance Base 65 Keyboard - Magnetic Switches $19.99 Delivered @ Mwave
body:
Deal: [Refurbished] Higround Blackice Performance Base 65 Keyboard - Magnetic Switches $19.99 Delivered @ Mwave

[Wiadro] worth it for the switches alone at that price
looks like a straight copy of the novel keys nk65
[camshandez] Surprisingly OP's "Higround BLACKICE Performance Base 65 Keyboard - Magnetic Switches "
Did not expect to see hall effect at this price point.
[heef] Thanks, another keeb won't hurt. Still haven't been able to move to anything but my Cherry Brown TKL Leopold I've used for years. Have an epomaker hall effect board and I find it very average.
[Wiadro] HF switches are horrible if you have used tactile switches for years.
[semtexpc] Thanks mate, jumped on one. thought for $20, cannot complain.
[bargainhuntr] Just observe the key caps do not have anything printed on
[Wiadro] good keeb to keep at work so no one needs to "hot desk" at your desk.
[HaventAKalou] It’s printed on the side. For some reason you can’t see it in a few of those pictures
[thangcuoi] The print is on the side, look at the keys from an angle.
I'm tempted to get one just as a new toy, but realistically, it's probably too noisy for my work environment, and doesn't have the number keys I need.
[HaydosK] Somehow missed the email. Thanks for posting.
[heef] FYI that the cheap Glorious keycaps are still on clearance at JB. Should be cheap delivery to metro areas too. Good quality and can add a bit of colour to this keeb.
Forest Green
Olive Green
Pastel
Credit to this deal
No shine-through if that matters to you.
[1ozbargainer] don't really need an extra keyboar but why not
[Benjiii] Have been looking to try Hall Effect switches.
Looks like 4 different Higround models (refurb) are on sale, all $20.
[angriestmaninsydney] Will dedicate this for gaming so I will always have the higround
[pinopio] Damn, OOS. Was keen to try magnetic switches. The translucent one looks pretty spiffy too though so might bite for the price even though it doesn't appear to Hall Effect.
[Blitzfx] Is the other mechanical switch variant worth $20? https://www.mwave.com.au/products/higround-snowstone-base-65…
[James-A] Considering that a set of White Flame Switches costs around $25 AUD alone, I'd say this is a good deal.
[buyer-123] Can verify
https://files.ozbargain.com.au/upload/409487/130553/img_6418…
[bdl] You can add to cart, but "No Stock" when attempting to check out
[Alpha2749] It is in-fact out of stock, while it allows you to add to cart, when in cart it says 'No Stock'.
Otherwise, this one does look the same as the mechanical variant which is still in stock, if that is what tripped you up? The difference is the 'Performance' word in the listing title, which has hall effect switches, vs regular linear mechanical switches.
[konichiwa] Maybe it was just a one off, but I got through checkout and got the confirmation email.
